title: Tax Simulator
subtitle: Get a first overview of your tax situation in just a few minutes

welcome.headline: How is your tax situation set up?
welcome.subline: Our free simulator organises your details and shows which tax topics may be relevant for you.
welcome.privacy: No registration required. Your data is not stored.

step2.title: Income & Expenses
step2.hint: The flat-rate deduction (Pauschbetrag) is 1,230 EUR/year. Only specify if your actual expenses exceed this amount.

step3.title: Family Situation
step3.hint: Married couples can benefit significantly from a tax class change (III/V or IV/IV).

step4.title: Special Deductions
step4.subtitle: Select all applicable situations — each can increase your tax advantage.

step5.title: Your Tax Estimate
step5.disclaimer: A non-binding, heavily simplified orientation — neither tax advice nor a calculation of your individual case. The tax assessment is carried out exclusively by a cooperating certified tax advisor (Steuerberater).

step6.title: Your Result
step6.merci: Thank you! We will get back to you within 24 hours.
step6.msgSalarie: For employees, work-related expenses, the commuter allowance and special deductions are common topics. A cooperating certified tax advisor will clarify how this applies to your case in a personal consultation.
step6.msgFreelance: For freelancers and the self-employed, business expenses, the EÜR and VAT returns are typical topics. We handle the ongoing bookkeeping; the tax assessment is carried out by a cooperating certified tax advisor.
step6.msgGerant: For company directors, compensation structure, shareholder loans and business costs are typical topics. We handle the ongoing bookkeeping; the tax assessment is carried out by a cooperating certified tax advisor.
step6.msgRetraite: For pensioners, medical costs, tradesperson services and household-related services are common topics. A cooperating certified tax advisor will assess your individual case.
step6.msgDouble: With two activities, the interplay of both income types is the central topic. We handle the ongoing bookkeeping; the tax assessment is carried out by a cooperating certified tax advisor.
